coverage_statuses.evidence_incomplete: No bounded mechanism, complete requirement, cumulative profile, or named tier has passing executable evidence.
coverage_statuses.mechanism_demonstrated: A bounded mechanism passed its cited executable checks; no complete requirement or profile claim follows.
coverage_statuses.requirement_verified: Every executable expectation required for the cited permanent requirement passed on the exact evidence baseline.
coverage_statuses.cumulative_profile_satisfied: Every applicable inherited requirement for the cited GCP profile passed on one exact baseline.
coverage_statuses.tier_claimable: Every applicable requirement for the cited named GKOS tier passed and the active catalog declares the tier complete.

assessment_types.self-attested: The implementing or affiliated party executed or attested the evidence.
assessment_types.independently-verified: A disclosed independent assessor executed and verified the exact-bound evidence.

claim_fields.requirements_verified: Computed permanent requirements whose catalog-declared complete fixture set passed.
claim_fields.profiles_claimed: Computed profiles only; an empty array is required when no cumulative profile is established.
claim_fields.tier_claims: Computed named tiers only; an empty array is required when no named tier is established.
